Dear The Synergist Team,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Communications Manager position. With a background in digital marketing and web development, I bring a unique blend of technical and organizational skills that align well with the operational needs of your team.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage multi-channel campaigns, coordinate content production, and maintain client websites. I am proficient in tools like WordPress, Canva, and Google Workspace, and I have experience with project tracking and vendor coordination. I am particularly drawn to The Synergist's mission of tackling global societal challenges through collaboration. I am eager to contribute to your campaigns and support your team's impactful work.

I am based in Belgium and fluent in English, with additional languages including Turkish and Dutch (B1). I am available for hybrid work in Brussels.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can support your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Junior Communications Manager position at The Synergist. Your mission to address complex global challenges through collaboration resonates deeply with me, and I am eager to bring my organizational skills and digital expertise to support your impactful work.

With over two years of experience in digital marketing and web development, I have developed a strong foundation in coordinating multi-channel campaigns and managing production workflows. At Episto, I am responsible for on-page SEO, content creation, and WordPress site maintenance, which has honed my ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines. I am proficient in tools like Asana, Google Workspace, WordPress, Canva, and Figma, and I quickly adapt to new technologies.

One of my key strengths is my proactive 'chaser' mindset. I am comfortable following up with vendors, developers, and internal teams to ensure projects stay on track. I take pride in keeping assets organized and maintaining clear communication across all stakeholders. My experience with project tracking and logistics, combined with my attention to detail, makes me well-suited to handle the operational demands of this role.

I am also passionate about content and social media. I have drafted social media posts and newsletters, and I understand how to use messaging frameworks to engage audiences. I am fluent in English and have working knowledge of Turkish and Dutch, which could be an asset in your diverse environment.

I am based in Belgium and excited about the hybrid work structure you offer. I am eager to contribute to your team and grow with The Synergist as you expand into new partnerships.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support your communications efforts.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
